_about: Layer 2 (product line) and layer 3 (series) of Cisco cable access (the 'video' category), 14 Sep 2026: GS7000 nodes and optical hubs, Prisma II optical transport, cBR-8, Remote PHY, RF Gateway, optical passives. Most legacy Scientific-Atlanta parts are bare 7-digit numbers whose NAME states the family ('(P2-HD-13TXF-15-SP) 1310HD Fwd Tx', 'GS7000 Fwd Config Module', 'RFGW-1 AC Power Supply'), so name rules place them; the 18-character G… / HA… / HB… SKUs are GS7000 node and optical-hub configuration codes. No role axis in this category.
